en: Colorized historical postcard view of a stone multi‑arch bridge over a river with several steam and passenger boats in the foreground. The riverside promenade is visible at the bottom, while the city skyline with historic buildings and church towers stretches along the far bank. Printed titles at the top read "Dresden." on the left and "Friedrich-August-Brücke." on the right. The nearest steamboat bears the name "KOENIG FRIEDRICH AUGUST" and another boat is labeled "BOHEMIA."
